content:
Hi Daniel,

I hope the move to the new office went smoothly! I know how chaotic those transitions can be.

I'm checking in on invoice 2041 ($1,250) for the January inventory dashboard work, which was sent on February 12 and due on March 14. It looks like it's still outstanding on our end, so I wanted to make sure it didn't get lost in the shuffle of the move.

I've attached the invoice again just in case. If you need any changes—like a different department name or a PO number—just let me know and I'll fix it right away.

Best regards,
Helena
